_comment: Curated roster of accounts whose posts carry weight. THIS IS A STARTING POINT --
you are expected to edit it. The app treats roster membership as the strongest
signal it has about who is talking, so a stale or padded roster degrades the
tier:      WHALE | KOL | ALPHA | RETAIL | BOT
followers: optional; omit rather than guess. Only used as a tiebreak.
wallets:   optional on-chain addresses. When present, the app cross-checks the
token's top holders and tells you whether they actually bought or
are only posting. That distinction is the entire point.
trackRecord: optional 0-1, your own hit rate for this account. Unset = unweighted.

roster.note: On-chain investigator. A post here is usually a warning, not a call.

_negativeSignals: Handles listed here are treated as adversarial coverage: a mention from
zachxbt is weighted as a RISK increase, not an endorsement.
